notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.notes:
Greetings, blacksmiths! The fires of our forge burn brighter than ever as we return with another exciting devlog for Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith.Today we're excited to showcase the significant improvements to three core mechanics that will transform how you craft legendary weapons and armors. Let's dive right into what makes crafting in Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith more immersive and satisfying than ever!

[h1]Forging: Master of the Anvil[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/709489c72184f4ae03a9344c00d7523c4d9ef567.png[/img]

The forge system has undergone a significant transformation to deliver a truly hands-on experience! Now you'll actively shape destiny with every strike of your hammer. Using sturdy pliers, you'll grip the glowing hot metal and position it precisely on the anvil. As long as the metal remains hot, powerful hammer blows will gradually transform that formless ingot into components worthy of legend.
Like any craft, there are secrets to master. Discover critical striking points that allow for faster and more efficient forging - a well-placed blow on these sweet spots will dramatically accelerate your progress. However, be warned! Repeatedly hammering the same location will weaken the metal's structural integrity. A true master blacksmith knows to vary their strikes, maintaining the perfect balance between speed and quality.
This dynamic approach transforms forging from a simple task into an engaging challenge that rewards skill and strategic thinking!

[h1]Assembly: Quality in Every Piece[/h1]

Our enhanced assembly system embraces a fundamental truth: a weapon is only as good as the sum of its parts.
With all your components ready, our improved assembly system lets you create weapons and armor with specific stats and qualities. Each piece contributes to the final item's power, with higher quality components yielding superior results. Our intuitive interface makes selecting and combining parts effortless, giving you unprecedented control over your creations. Choose the best quality components to craft the perfect weapon for any situation!

[h1]Sharpening: The Perfect Edge[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/94389671e64889c4d812cbc313486bff0b4131b4.jpg[/img]

What use is even the finest crafted blade without a proper edge? Your customers and heroes certainly aren't looking for dull showpieces! Our revamped sharpening mini-game brings more realistic and satisfying mechanics to this crucial final step.
The challenge lies in the technique - you must carefully position your blade against the grinding wheel at precisely the correct angle. Holding the blade in one position for too long or using inconsistent angles will result in subpar edges. Only through mastering this delicate dance of blade and stone will you create weapons with edges so keen they can slice through a falling leaf before it touches the ground.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue forging Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith into the ultimate blacksmithing experience!
The Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith Team

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow blacksmiths! Greetings, fellow blacksmiths! In our previous devlog, we shared our vision of expanding Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith with more RPG elements, and today, I'm thrilled to unveil one of our most significant steps in that direction - the Adventure System! This new feature transforms your role from a simple blacksmith to a master craftsman who outfits and manages heroes on their quests.

Adventures Await!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/9536dedc81fe71ce59643fb856e65ba15f559a33.gif[/img]

At the heart of our Adventure System lies the Adventure Table, a dynamic board that refreshes regularly with new opportunities for glory. Here, you'll find a variety of quests waiting to be undertaken, each with its own requirements, rewards, and challenges.  Each Adventure comes with crucial information you'll need to consider:
* Required Power Level: The strength needed for success
* Special Traits: Unique requirements that could give your heroes an edge
* Duration: How long your heroes will be away
* Rewards: The treasures and resources awaiting successful completion

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/c21fec3c5dcad826d2eb252811f4ca01136f532a.jpg[/img]

Heroes: Your Trusted Companions In Adventures

What good is a masterfully crafted sword without a hero to wield it? When you select an adventure, you'll be able to assign your heroes based on their unique traits and power levels. The system calculates a success rate based on how well your chosen team matches the adventure's requirements. A hero with the right trait might be worth their weight in gold for certain quests!

Want to know your chances? The success calculation system is transparent and intuitive:
* Meeting the power requirement gives you a solid base success rate
* Matching traits provide additional bonuses
* The right combination of heroes can guarantee success!

Adventure Outcomes
Once you've assembled your team and launched an adventure, you can track its progress in the In Progress section. Watch as the countdown timer ticks away, bringing your heroes closer to either triumph or defeat. But fear not - the rewards are worth the risk! Successful adventures yield:
* Essential crafting resources
* Gold to expand your business
* Experience for your heroes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/25c40f03dad0d7963ab877f43c2cde5b69ed8904.jpg[/img]

A Living System
The Adventure System isn't just about sending heroes out and waiting for returns. It's a dynamic, evolving feature that adds depth to every aspect of Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith. Every weapon you forge, every piece of armor you craft, could be the key to success in a crucial adventure. Each successful quest not only brings valuable resources but also helps your heroes gain experience and grow stronger. As they level up, you'll unlock access to more challenging adventures with even greater rewards!

Stay tuned for new updates!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Dear Blacksmiths,
It's been a while since our demo release. Your valuable feedback has helped shape the game's design significantly. Our vision has evolved to incorporate more RPG elements and create a deeper crafting experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/7702c9ed188eed7bd28b0053ea4b2ac74459cf9e.gif[/img]

[b]Where Are We Heading?[/b] Crafting remains the backbone of Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith. As a master blacksmith, you'll forge weapons and armor for customers, mine ores, and equip heroes and adventurers from your village. These champions can be sent on dungeons and quests to gather weapons, armor, and resources - which you can then repair, scrap, or sell. You'll also serve your kingdom during wartime. This direction has led us to focus on enhancing management and RPG elements rather than creating a typical simulation game.

[b]Quality System Overhaul:[/b] We've completely revamped the quality system. In the demo, qualities could be directly selected while crafting an item - for instance, you could simply choose to craft a rare Copperside Sword from the assembly table with minimal additional resources. We found this too simplistic for our vision. The new system is skill-driven with RNG elements, giving you more control over the crafting process. On the anvil, a part's rarity now depends on your talent tree, the anvil's upgrade level, and the treatments you've applied. During assembly, you can influence the final item's rarity by choosing specific components - using an epic sword base instead of a common one increases the chance of crafting a higher-quality weapon. This system provides more meaningful choices and greater control over crafting outcomes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/715faceab9e7992a912f443db7cf6fbae5474279.png[/img]

[b]New Mechanics:[/b] We've expanded beyond basic blacksmithing to include repair and salvage systems. The new repair table allows you to service customer orders and maintain your heroes' equipment. Remember, broken gear becomes unusable until repaired. We've also added a scrapping table where you can dismantle unwanted weapons and armor to reclaim raw materials. These additions create an engaging resource management layer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/349c5d518cc42e70f6216bbb27400e7b5d6277cd.jpg[/img]

[b]Hero System:[/b] To give crafted items more purpose, we've introduced a hero system. Heroes are paid companions who serve your forge. Send them on quests and into dungeons to discover new weapons, armor, gold, resources, and recipes. Currently, there are five hero classes: Warrior, Priest, Mage, Rogue, and Hunter. Each class has a primary stat that significantly influences their power level as they grow stronger.

[b]Mini-Game Improvements:[/b] We've enhanced all existing mini-games, from assembly to sharpening, and are considering new ones for scrapping and repairing mechanics.

[b]Additional Updates:[/b]
Implemented inventory stacking system
Redesigned user interfaces
And many more improvements
We're excited to continue developing Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith and look forward to sharing more updates with you soon!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Listen up ye beardless wonders! I, Alper, a developer from far lands, am here to chronicle the fiery creation of our upcoming game, "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith."  In this devlog, we'll delve deep into the heart of the forge, where we'll be crafting not just weapons and armor, but an immersive world brimming with possibility! So, grab a tankard of your favorite ale, and join me on this epic journey from the first spark to a masterpiece worthy of the dwarven halls!

Mining

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/23f10267ed0e23980e91e596caf1f6c5f616d846.gif[/img]

A dwarf wouldn't be caught dead without a trusty pickaxe in hand!  In "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith," our mining mechanics are as straightforward as a good swing of a hammer.  Dwarven players will equip their pickaxes and delve into the mine shafts, where veins of precious ore await.  These deposits will be visually distinct, allowing you to quickly identify the iron, copper, or even rarer materials needed to forge legendary equipment.  So, grab your pickaxe, fellow beardlings, and let's get digging!


Smelting

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/634531f9b67ad20ed66e84212798c2e365de714b.gif[/img]

No true blacksmith prospers without the fiery heart of the forge!  In "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith," your humble shop will house a trusty smelter, where the magic of transformation happens.  Here, dwarven players will take their hard-earned ores and combine them with glowing coal.  The intense heat will work its wonders, separating the impurities from the raw materials and leaving behind pure metal bars.  Watch in satisfaction as your iron ore transforms into gleaming iron ingots, ready to be shaped into weapons and armor fit for a legend!

Forging

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/d74cbe0201801000a56af56f357a2abba3058257.gif[/img]

The true test of a dwarf's skill lies in the forge!  "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith" brings the art of forging to life.  Here, players will no longer be limited to just crafting finished products.  Instead, you'll have the freedom to choose what to create, piece by piece.  Once you decide what to craft, heat the metal to a perfect glow within the forge.  Then, with a resounding clang, strike the hot metal upon the anvil.  Feel the satisfying resistance as your hammer shapes the raw material into a beautifully forged component, ready to be assembled into a legendary weapon or a suit of armor that will sing the song of dwarven craftsmanship!

Assembly

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/4e4bff4d387e835e1c0cc829214cff290acf6989.gif[/img]

In the vein of dwarven ingenuity, "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith" takes crafting beyond the forge!  Here, the assembly table becomes your battlefield, where the individual pieces you've meticulously crafted transform into legendary equipment.  No more waiting for a finished product – you hold the power of creation in your hands.  Using a detailed recipe book as your guide, you'll gather the necessary components, be they fresh-from-the-forge parts you've personally crafted, high-quality materials procured from a smithing vendor, or perhaps even rare trophies looted from a thrilling dungeon delve.  Each piece fits together like a well-oiled mechanism, culminating in the triumphant assembly of a powerful weapon or a suit of armor that reflects your skill and resourcefulness.  So, dwarven crafter, unleash your inner inventor and assemble masterpieces that will be the envy of the realm!


Sharpening

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/05cd737a04f47e74e8ac657779998b10fcd0d8e4.gif[/img]

Even the finest dwarven steel needs a keen edge to reach its full potential!  "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith" acknowledges this crucial step with its sharpening mechanic.  Here, a simple yet satisfying task awaits – taking your freshly crafted weapon to the grinder.  With a practiced motion, you'll secure the item in the sharpener and watch as it spins, the grinding wheel whispering away imperfections.  With each turn, the metal gleams brighter, its edge growing ever more deadly.  Soon, your creation will transform from a blunt instrument to a razor-sharp weapon, capable of slicing through opponents with terrifying ease.  Remember, a true dwarven weapon is not just forged with fire, but honed to lethal perfection!


That's a fantastic breakdown of the core mechanics in "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith," fellow dwarf! We've journeyed from the depths of the mine to the fiery heart of the forge, and finally, to the sharpening wheel where raw materials are transformed into instruments of legend.  This is but a taste of what awaits in our upcoming devlogs!  In the coming weeks, we'll delve deeper into the world, exploring the impact of item quality, venturing into diverse zones, and unlocking the secrets of enchantments.  We'll also shatter unwanted equipment through salvaging, delve into the mysteries of the adventure table, and conquer perilous dungeons.  So, stay tuned, dear beardlings, as we continue to forge the future of "Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith" together!
